drhp.business: Sigma Solve is an Ahmedabad-headquartered IT company offering enterprise software development, turnkey consultancy, Web & E-commerce development, Real Time Application development, Business Intelligence Analytics, CRM development, digital marketing, UI & UX design, automation testing and quality assurance. Almost 100% of revenue is from export of services, executed jointly with its wholly-owned US subsidiary Sigma Solve Inc., which books nearly all client sales and to which the Indian company charges execution fees on a per-man-hour basis.
drhp.expansion: The company describes investing in upgrading and modernizing its technical infrastructure and technology to equip its technical team, and in optimizing utilisation of existing resources through improved processes, rather than any named physical capacity project.

litigation.note: Directors' Report states there are no significant and material orders passed by Regulators/Courts/Tribunals against the company (Board's Report, item 36).

moat.body:
- customer lock-in: sticky customer base from understanding customers' complex requirements and translating them into customized solutions — evidence: company states this approach 'helps us in creating a sticky customer base'
- distribution: low-cost customer acquisition via word-of-mouth from its user network — evidence: 'allows us to gain new customers at a low acquisition cost'

- Company is exposed to credit risk per MD&A Risks and Concerns.
